name: Salus
tagline: Combines insurance, public aid and hospital assistance to cut a patient's medical bill, keeping data private.
problem: Coverage exists but is split across insurers, public programs and hospital aid that do not talk to each other, leaving patients with surprise bills.
solution: A coordination-of-benefits engine with agents that check a bill against private insurance, public aid and hospital assistance, under a zero-trust design where patient data stays local.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a bill and see how much each program covers.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of MongoDB Atlas” among 160 submissions.
Opens with a personal pharmacy story.
Privacy-first design fits a health-data problem.

lessons: A first-person story of being turned away at the counter makes the stakes concrete.
